output.one_liner: Freshdesk is a cloud-based customer support platform for managing tickets, customer communications, and helpdesk operations.

auth.notes: API key authentication only. MCP integration also requires API key.

evidence.snippet: Currently, Freshdesk allows you to authenticate requests involved in MCP integration by using an API key only.

access.notes: 14-day free trial with full API access included. After trial, API access available only on paid plans (Growth, Pro, Enterprise). Free tier has zero API calls.

evidence.snippet: Every new account starts with a 14-day free trial that includes: Full feature access
No, the access to Freshdesk APIs and the integration capabilities is not available in the free Sprout plan.
Free: 0 calls per minute. Growth: 100 calls per minute. Pro: 400 calls per minute.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Per-minute rate limits by plan: Free (0), Growth (100), Pro (400), Enterprise (700). Separate per-endpoint limits also enforced.

evidence.snippet: Freshdesk's APIs belong to the Representational State Transfer (REST) category.
They allow you to perform 'RESTful' operations such as reading, modifying, adding or deleting data from your helpdesk.
The number of API calls you can make is based on your plan.
The Freshworks Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables AI tools like Cursor and Claude to securely connect and interact with Freshdesk.
MCP server for Freshdesk — 194 tools, stdio & HTTP transports, full Zod validation.

buildability.rationale: REST API with broad endpoint coverage is fully documented and accessible via free trial, but production use requires paid subscription after 14 days.
